summary: Backend: 22/22 pytest passed (100%). All required endpoints — healthcheck, loan-types (8), banks (6 with EMI & 1 best_value), faqs (6), promise, OTP request/verify (incl. 6-digit validation), auth/me with Bearer, profile update, applications CRUD + documents (base64 excluded on GET list), submit + 8-stage timeline, _id excluded everywhere, 401 for missing/invalid token, 404 for missing app — all verified. Frontend: splash → /welcome → /auth/login → /auth/otp → /onboarding flow works and OTP creates a session. CRITICAL BLOCKER: onboarding submit returns 422 (Pydantic EmailStr rejects empty string), which prevents reaching /(tabs). Because onboarding is blocked, none of the tab screens (Home, Loans, Status, Profile), Apply flow, EMI calculator, Bank Compare or /promise could be exercised post-login (auth-gated). TestID naming mismatch on onboarding fields (`ob-name`, `ob-city`, `ob-state`, `ob-dob`, `ob-pan` vs. expected `*-input`).

ui_bugs.issue: Submit returns HTTP 422 because the form sends `email: ""` (empty string) which fails Pydantic `EmailStr` validation on backend ProfileUpdate. User is stuck on /onboarding and cannot reach /(tabs). RCA: /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx line 46-52 spreads `{...form}` including empty optional fields (email, gender, aadhaar, monthly_income, company_name, marital_status, employment_type, cibil_score). Fix: strip empty strings / undefined before calling updateProfile, OR change backend ProfileUpdate.email to `Optional[str]` with manual regex (currently EmailStr).

Review request expected `ob-name-input`, `ob-city-input`, `ob-state-input`, `ob-dob-input`, `ob-pan-input`, but code uses `ob-name`, `ob-city`, `ob-state`, `ob-dob`, `ob-pan` (no `-input` suffix). Reference: /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx:78-91. Either align the testIDs or update spec.

Public `/promise` page redirects to /welcome when user is not authenticated. The review request and Welcome screen marketing flow suggest /promise should be accessible without login. Likely the global auth guard is too aggressive (catches all routes). Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by 422 — user stays on /onboarding indefinitely; no error toast is shown to the user (silent failure).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: `"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".` — fires multiple times during render. Search and replace usages of `shadowColor / shadowOffset / shadowOpacity / shadowRadius` in stylesheets to use the new `boxShadow` shorthand or `elevation` for Android. Reference: across multiple style files in /app/frontend/app/** and /app/frontend/src/components/**.

Console warning: `[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.` — push token listeners are wired up unconditionally. Guard registration with `Platform.OS !== 'web'` to silence and prevent runtime no-ops.

Either (a) in /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx submit(), filter out empty-string / null / undefined fields before calling updateProfile, OR (b) loosen backend ProfileUpdate.email to Optional[str] in /app/backend/server.py and validate format only when non-empty.

FIX (LOW): Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow / elevation in StyleSheet objects (frontend-wide).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 281: `PUT /me/profile` — `email: Optional[EmailStr]` will 422 on `""`. Should accept empty/null gracefully.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI `@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown')` — migrate to lifespan context (warnings will appear in newer FastAPI).
server.py — file is reasonable size (~590 lines) but mixes models, routes, helpers, push integration. Consider splitting models / routers / services for maintainability.
Frontend onboarding.tsx submit spreads entire form including empty optional strings — fragile against any backend EmailStr/regex-strict field.

rca_of_issue: Onboarding 422 RCA — Pydantic v2 EmailStr rejects empty string. The frontend form initializes `email: ""` and includes it in the PUT payload via `{...form}` spread, even though `Optional[EmailStr]` should accept null. Repro: log in with any 10-digit mobile + any 6-digit OTP, leave email blank, fill name/city/state/dob/pan, tap Continue → network returns 422 → user is stuck on /onboarding silently. Mitigation options: (1) strip falsy values in submit, (2) coerce empty to null/undefined, (3) backend changes EmailStr to a regex-validated Optional[str].
